amended.freeze_digests_note: These four guards hash the common sources, so the amendment moved them. They did their job: they detected it. The closure record keeps its own historical values UNREWRITTEN; this record names every digest the amendment moved and its new value, so an unauthorized change to clinical_core still matches neither record. Only calibration is unchanged, because it does not hash derived.py.

reason: P3-117 showed the certified hypoventilation -> oxygenation equation is structurally useful but the frozen interface could express only all-or-nothing transmission. The only quantity that scaled it was respiratory_quotient, a respiratory quotient (~0.7-1.0 physiologically), which the measured region would have forced to >= 13.2; the alternatives forced a normal PaCO2 of ~3 mmHg or were inert. Expressing partial transmission by abusing a quantity that means something else was refused, so the amendment adds the control the physiology actually needed.

unchanged: the ODC inversion and the latent PaO2 representation
the relative form: Patm, PH2O and the absolute alveolar gas equation still cancel
SpO2_base, which stays the certified G / L -> G / FiO2 path of P2O-3
the FiO2 and G rules: the fraction never multiplies retained(G)
the P2T-5 refusal of the hypoxaemic drive (HYPOXEMIC_FEEDBACK_LOOP_DEFERRED)

parameter.name: hypoventilation_oxygenation_transmission_fraction
parameter.default_meaning: UNSCALED: reproduces the certified P2T-5 full transmission bit for bit. It is NOT a second off switch for the link, which respiratory_quotient still owns.

evidence: every committed profile keeps respiratory_quotient = None, so the link stays off and no reading moves
fraction None and fraction 1.0 give bit-identical SpO2 (25.249191654270817 on opioid_35m at R = 0.8), and that is the value measured before the amendment
fraction 0.0 returns SpO2_base itself, without a round trip through the dissociation relation
no profile is converted to a nonzero fraction automatically

findings: the direct SpO2 -> respiratory drive edge is absent (hypoxaemic_drive_mapping is None) and the P2T-5 invariant refuses it
the PaCO2 -> metabolic acid burden edge does not exist: doubling the PaCO2 reference leaves the burden at exactly 0, so there is no double counting
the one closed loop runs SpO2 -> DO2 -> oxygen deficit -> D -> acid burden (accumulated, cleared with tau_acid) -> acid drive -> RR -> W -> PaCO2 -> SpO2
that loop is CONDITIONALLY_ACTIVE, gated by D > 0: on opioid_35m D is exactly 0 for fraction <= 0.818522 and positive above it, so it is dormant throughout the development region
when active its sign is NEGATIVE (compensatory): RR rises, PaCO2 falls, the hypoxaemia is opposed
in asthma it never activates, even at fraction 1.0: PaCO2 and RR stay bit-identical
16 trajectories across 4 cases and fraction in {0.06, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0}: 0 sign inversions, no oscillation, no runaway, monotone in the fraction

not_claimed: a faculty-approved value for the fraction
